## 中文原文
你午休时想趴在桌上小憩一会儿，刚闭上眼睛，隔壁工位同事一直在打电话，声音不小。你不好直接打断，只好戴上降噪耳机，试着继续休息。

## My translation
During the lunch break, I was going to take a nap on my desk.
When I just closed my eyes, the colleague by the side was making a phone call all the time, which was a bit noisy.
I couldn't interrupt him, so I had to put on my denoising headphones and tried to have a rest as usual.

## Revised version
During my lunch break, I was about to take a nap at the desk.
I'd just closed my eyes when the colleague next to me kept talking on the phone. That was pretty noisy.
I didn't want to interrupt him, so I put on my noise-concelling headphones and tried to get some rest.

## Key phrases
- take a nap at the desk, 用at
- I'd just closed my eyes when...，表示刚闭上眼就
- colleague next to me，隔壁的同事
- noise-concelling headphones，降噪耳机
